headline: CenterPoint Energy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Improve Y/Y
summary: CNP's Q2 adjusted earnings beat estimates as revenues rise 10.7% year over year and operating income climbs to $534 million.

headline: DTE Energy's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Decrease Year Over Year
summary: DTE beats Q2 earnings estimates but posts a year-over-year decline as grid upgrades, storage investments and segment swings shape results.
